about_the_game:
World's Goodest Pup is a cozy roguelike deckbuilder where you perform in dog shows! Collect new tricks, build your pet resort, unlock breeds, and accessorize at shops as you make your way to the top dog podium. With hand-drawn animations and boppin' music, fluffy, heartwarming runs await!

Wag and bark your way into the competition, where agility, style, and obedience are your keys to victory. Start by choosing your companion from a variety of breeds, each with their own unique cards. Through strategic deck-building, you'll train your dog and level up.

Build and customize your pet resort as you grow and bring new breeds into your fold. As you collect new buildings and beautiful decorations, you can arrange to best suit your tastes.

As you travel through the city, from small dog park to stadium, assemble different builds to tackle unique situations. Each stage is a chance for you and your pup to bond.

World's Goodest Pup is designed to be a relaxing and positive experience, making it perfect for animal lovers of all ages. Dive into a beautifully crafted world where the competition is friendly, and the focus is on the joy and camaraderie of dog shows.

Features:

  • Endless Replayability: With procedurally generated competitions and challenges, no two playthroughs are the same

  • A Variety of Dog Breeds: Choose from a wide range of breeds, each with unique stats and abilities

  • Build Your Pet Resort: Decorate and arrange your dream paradise for your fluffy friends

  • Artifacts, items, and cards galore: Combine different strategies to adapt to your dog's situation

  • Wholesome Content: A cozy game experience focused on the love of animals
